stages.detail: The cloud runtime check completed with 16,384 particles and the approved 0.04 m grid. Box settlement occurred at 1.34 s.
All 1,000 unique episodes are uploaded: 776 training, 109 validation and 115 test. Every episode has 251 post-settlement frames. Stored HDF5 size: 125.28 GB; no rejected seeds.
10,000 updates on four NVIDIA L40 GPUs; optimization took 653.5 seconds. Validation selected update 7,500. The selected checkpoint has been downloaded and verified locally.

All 12 held-out five-second rollouts remain finite but are worse than stationary sand. Median final error is 7.06 cm versus 1.65 cm for the frozen-particle baseline. Local compiled particle steps take about 17.3 ms on RTX 5090; this excludes rigid dynamics and force estimation.

notes: Some dynamic-box trajectories reach the rigid ground outside the sand pile. The recorder stores sand-on-box force but not direct ground-on-box force. A large translational force residual is flagged in the metadata rather than treated as a complete contact-force label; episode 456 was checked at its largest residual and its lowest box corner was 4.8 mm below the rigid-ground plane.

The new inference code advances particles without MPM while replaying current box pose and velocity from a held-out recording. It does not yet integrate the analytical force estimator or advance box motion independently.
